stories.title: R Praggnanandhaa became the first Indian to win Norway Chess (5 June 2026)
stories.body: beating World No. 1 Magnus Carlsen twice and clinching the title with a final-round win over Vincent Keymer.

one_liners: R Praggnanandhaa became the first Indian to win Norway Chess (5 June 2026) — beating World No. 1 Magnus Carlsen twice and clinching the title with a final-round win over Vincent Keymer.
